questions.corrige_markdown:
Expand each bracket, taking care with the minus sign in front of the second one.

$3(x-2y)=3x-6y$ and $-2(x+5y)=-2x-10y$.

$3x-6y-2x-10y=(3x-2x)+(-6y-10y)=x-16y$.

**Answer: $x-16y$.**
